caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, light background. The main object is a metallic kettle with a round base and a curved, narrow spout to the left. The kettle has a wide, circular opening at the top and a large, flat, hinged handle that arches above the kettle and is attached on both sides by an ornamental hinge. The metal surface of the kettle is depicted in shades of brown and copper, with darker shading to indicate wear and shadow, and some lighter highlights that suggest a reflective texture. Above and to the left of the kettle is a separate, circular lid, featuring a raised knob in the center and layered circular ridges, matching the kettle's color scheme. Both objects are centrally positioned within a faintly outlined rectangular border on the paper, with the kettle occupying the lower right and the lid positioned above it, indicating they are parts of the same item.
title: Copper Kettle
